early_warning: Any ad, brief or listing published pre-certificate
control: Hard compliance gate at week 6; no campaign asset leaves the folder before the MahaRERA number and QR code exist

early_warning: A single number compared against another without a declared basis
control: area_basis and price_type mandatory NOT NULL; comparisons blocked across bases in the workbook

early_warning: Zero qualified leads by end of month 3
control: Hard cap of 20 h/week research after month 4; the workload model is a budget, not a description

early_warning: Month 6 with no closure and no offer on the table
control: 12-month runway funded before start; rental desk switched on by month 6 to cover fixed costs

early_warning: Listings vanish, duplicates rise, or a scraping notice arrives
control: Manual/permitted collection only; own field observations and closed deals become the primary asset

early_warning: KYC or contact data held without notice, consent or retention limit
control: Notice + consent at first capture; minimum-necessary collection; documented retention and deletion
Status ladder with slippage_months; only operational assets carry full weight in scoring

early_warning: Client or developer disputes entitlement after closure
control: Written terms before every engagement; documented introduction trail; payout-days tracked per counterparty

early_warning: One developer above 40% of pipeline commission
control: Concentration tracked monthly; co-broking and resale kept live alongside primary

early_warning: Advice given beyond the verified record
control: Title opinions only from qualified counsel; unknowns flagged as unknown in writing

early_warning: High enquiry count, few site visits
control: Qualified lead is the KPI, defined by budget + timeline + decision authority + area fit

early_warning: A client finds a number that moved and you did not know
control: stale_after_days per domain; freshness shown on every client-facing screen

early_warning: Corridor 2 opened while corridor 1 still needs the founder in every deal
control: Expansion gate: corridor 1 must produce closures without founder presence in every step

early_warning: Single point of failure across all six workstreams
control: Written playbooks from day one; every process documented so it can be handed over
